You make out a fridge. You can see a closed conventional looking oven nearby. Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? However, the table, like an empty table, has nothing on it. You smell a sickening smell, and follow it to a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can make out a banana and a cookbook. Now that's what I call TextWorld! You can make out a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it!

There is an open plain door leading east. There is a closed patio door leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a red hot pepper and a raw yellow potato on the floor.
